q21749.en: The sign shown advises the vehicles pictured on the panel to follow the direction indicated.

explain.short: The panel shows a road train and an articulated lorry under an arrow: it advises those vehicles to go that way.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'consiglia' (advises) is right: this is advice, not an order.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries are advised to turn right here

q21750.en: The sign shown gives advance notice of a recommended detour for road trains and articulated lorries passing through.

explain.short: It announces a recommended route for heavy lorries that are only passing through the area.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'deviazione consigliata' (recommended detour): advised, not compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Recommended detour for lorries

q21751.en: The sign shown advises the categories of vehicles pictured to turn right.

explain.short: The arrow bends to the right, so the pictured lorries are advised to turn right.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'consiglia' (advises): the right turn is advice, not an obligation.

sceneParams.caption: Advice for lorries: turn right

q21752.en: The sign shown is not an obligation sign.

explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'non è' (is not): the statement is negative and correct.

sceneParams.caption: Information, not obligation

q21753.en: The sign shown advises road trains and articulated lorries which way to go so they do not cross the built-up area.

explain.short: The recommended route keeps big lorries out of the town centre.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'per non attraversare' (so as not to cross): the route goes around the town, not into it.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries: go around the town, not through it

q21754.en: The sign shown forbids road trains and articulated lorries to turn right.

explain.short: It is the opposite: it advises these lorries to turn right. It forbids nothing.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is wrong: the sign advises a right turn.

sceneParams.caption: Not a ban: lorries are advised to turn right

q21755.en: The sign shown tells lorries to overtake on the right.

explain.short: The arrow shows a direction to take, not an overtake. It advises a right turn.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'sorpassare' (overtake) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not overtaking: a recommended right turn

q21756.en: The sign shown shows lorries the way to the town centre.

explain.short: The route is advised to keep heavy lorries AWAY from the town centre, not to lead them there.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'centro cittadino' (town centre) is the opposite: the route avoids the centre.

sceneParams.caption: It leads lorries around the centre, not into it

q21757.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of an obligation for the pictured vehicles to turn right immediately.

explain.short: There is no obligation: the white panel only advises. A compulsory direction would be a round blue sign.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation) is wrong: it is only advice.

sceneParams.caption: Advice only, no obligation to turn

q21758.en: The sign shown means that the vehicles pictured on the panel must turn right immediately.

explain.short: The lorries are only advised to turn right: nothing says they must, and not immediately.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'devono' (must) is wrong: the sign advises, it does not order.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries get advice, not an order

q21759.en: The sign shown warns lorries in advance to move into the right lane to get past an obstacle.

explain.short: The curved arrow means turning into another road, not changing lane around an obstacle.
explain.rule: This white panel with a curved arrow and two lorries is an information sign: it ADVISES road trains (autotreni, lorry + trailer) and articulated lorries (autoarticolati) to take that direction, usually to avoid the town centre. It is not an obligation.
explain.trap: 'superare un ostacolo' (get past an obstacle) is wrong: it is a recommended route.

sceneParams.caption: A recommended route, not an obstacle

q21760.en: The sign shown marks a stop for out-of-town public transport buses.

explain.short: The bus on the blue sign marks a stop for public buses that link towns (extraurbano).
explain.rule: Blue rectangle with a bus in a white square: 'fermata autobus extraurbano' (stop for public buses that travel between towns). It marks where you wait for the bus; a timetable panel may be added below.
explain.trap: 'extraurbano' means outside towns: this is the stop for intercity buses.

sceneParams.caption: Stop for out-of-town public buses

q21761.en: The sign shown may be combined with a panel that shows the departure times of the out-of-town buses.

explain.short: Under the stop sign there may be a panel with the bus timetable.
explain.rule: Blue rectangle with a bus in a white square: 'fermata autobus extraurbano' (stop for public buses that travel between towns). It marks where you wait for the bus; a timetable panel may be added below.
explain.trap: 'può essere' (may be): the timetable panel is possible, not always there.

sceneParams.caption: A timetable panel may be added

q21762.en: The sign shown marks the place where you wait for an out-of-town public transport bus.

explain.short: A bus stop is exactly the place where passengers wait for the bus.
explain.rule: Blue rectangle with a bus in a white square: 'fermata autobus extraurbano' (stop for public buses that travel between towns). It marks where you wait for the bus; a timetable panel may be added below.
explain.trap: 'aspettare' (wait): a stop is where you wait for the bus.

sceneParams.caption: Wait here for the out-of-town bus

q21763.en: The sign shown means no entry for buses.

explain.short: A ban would be a round sign with a red border. This blue rectangle marks a bus stop.
explain.rule: Blue rectangle with a bus in a white square: 'fermata autobus extraurbano' (stop for public buses that travel between towns). It marks where you wait for the bus; a timetable panel may be added below.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito' (no entry) is wrong: it is a bus stop.

sceneParams.caption: Not a ban on buses: a bus stop

q21764.en: The sign shown marks a lane reserved for buses.

explain.short: This sign marks a bus stop, not a bus lane.
explain.rule: Blue rectangle with a bus in a white square: 'fermata autobus extraurbano' (stop for public buses that travel between towns). It marks where you wait for the bus; a timetable panel may be added below.
explain.trap: 'corsia riservata' (reserved lane) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not a bus lane: a bus stop

q21765.en: The sign shown marks a parking area for buses and trolleybuses.

explain.short: Buses stop here only to let passengers on and off; it is not an area where buses park.
explain.rule: Blue rectangle with a bus in a white square: 'fermata autobus extraurbano' (stop for public buses that travel between towns). It marks where you wait for the bus; a timetable panel may be added below.
explain.trap: 'area di sosta' (parking area) is wrong: a 'fermata' is a short stop for passengers.

sceneParams.caption: Not bus parking: a passenger stop

q21766.en: The sign shown marks a road reserved for buses.

explain.short: Other vehicles may also use this road. The sign only marks a bus stop.
explain.rule: Blue rectangle with a bus in a white square: 'fermata autobus extraurbano' (stop for public buses that travel between towns). It marks where you wait for the bus; a timetable panel may be added below.
explain.trap: 'strada riservata' (reserved road) is wrong: it is a stop.

sceneParams.caption: Not a bus-only road: a bus stop

q21767.en: The sign shown indicates a car park and a bus stop nearby.

explain.short: The P is the car park and the bus with numbers is a bus stop close by.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'nelle vicinanze' (nearby): the bus stop is close to the car park.

sceneParams.caption: Park here, then take the bus

q21768.en: The sign shown is placed near a bus stop.

explain.short: The park and ride is next to a bus stop, so the sign is near that stop.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'vicino' (near): the stop for lines 8 and 45 is close by.

sceneParams.caption: Bus stop close to the car park

q21769.en: The sign shown means that after parking your car you can take bus no. 8 or no. 45.

explain.short: The numbers 8 and 45 are the bus lines you can take after parking.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'n. 8 o n. 45': these are bus line numbers, not times.

sceneParams.caption: Park, then take bus 8 or 45

q21770.en: The sign shown gives the numbers (8 and 45) of the public buses that stop nearby.

explain.short: The red circles show the line numbers of the buses that stop near the car park.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'numero (8 e 45)' are line numbers, not a count of buses.

sceneParams.caption: Lines 8 and 45 stop nearby

q21771.en: The sign shown indicates that you can park your car and take the bus.

explain.short: This is the idea of park and ride: leave the car and continue by bus.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'parcheggiare ... e di prendere l'autobus': both parts are on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Park and ride

q21772.en: The sign shown marks a lay-by where buses park.

explain.short: The P is for cars. The bus symbol is a bus line you can take, not a place where buses park.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'piazzola di sosta per autobus' (bus lay-by) is wrong: the car park is for your car.

sceneParams.caption: Car park for you, not a lay-by for buses

q21773.en: The sign shown is placed near an emergency department (first aid).

explain.short: The black '+' means 'plus' (car park plus bus). The first aid sign has a red cross.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'pronto soccorso' (emergency department): the '+' is not a hospital cross.

sceneParams.caption: The + means 'plus', not first aid

q21774.en: The sign shown gives the maximum number of buses that may park.

explain.short: 8 and 45 are bus line numbers, not a maximum number of buses.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'numero massimo' (maximum number) is wrong: they are line numbers.

sceneParams.caption: 8 and 45 are bus lines, not a limit

q21775.en: The sign shown tells you for how many minutes a bus stays stopped.

explain.short: The numbers are not minutes: they are the bus lines 8 and 45.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'minuti' (minutes) is wrong: they are line numbers.

sceneParams.caption: Not minutes: bus lines 8 and 45

q21776.en: The sign shown means that you may start parking from 8:45.

explain.short: 8 and 45 are two separate bus lines, not the time 8:45.
explain.rule: White panel with P + bus and the numbers 8 and 45: a 'parcheggio di scambio' (park and ride). You leave the car here and take bus line 8 or 45, which stop nearby. The '+' means 'plus'; the numbers are bus lines.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 8.45' (from 8:45) is a trick: the two numbers are bus lines.

sceneParams.caption: Not a time: lines 8 and 45

q21777.en: The sign shown is found near a railway station.

explain.short: The car is loaded on a train wagon, so the sign is near a railway station.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a train wagon carrying a car and a bed: a railway station where cars travel on the train with their owner ('auto al seguito'). It is near the entrance where cars are loaded. The traveller rides in the train, not in the car.
explain.trap: 'stazione ferroviaria' (railway station): the wagon in the picture shows the train.

sceneParams.caption: Railway station with car transport

q21778.en: The sign shown indicates that a large railway station is nearby, where cars can be carried on the train with the traveller.

explain.short: Car and bed on a wagon: the traveller rides the train and the car travels with them.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a train wagon carrying a car and a bed: a railway station where cars travel on the train with their owner ('auto al seguito'). It is near the entrance where cars are loaded. The traveller rides in the train, not in the car.
explain.trap: 'al seguito del viaggiatore' (travelling with the passenger): the car goes on the same train.

sceneParams.caption: Your car travels on the train with you

q21779.en: The sign shown is near the entrance for cars that are to be loaded onto the train.

explain.short: It guides drivers to the place where cars go onto the train.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a train wagon carrying a car and a bed: a railway station where cars travel on the train with their owner ('auto al seguito'). It is near the entrance where cars are loaded. The traveller rides in the train, not in the car.
explain.trap: 'accesso' (entrance): the sign is near the loading entrance for cars.

sceneParams.caption: Entrance for loading cars on the train

q21780.en: On roads outside towns, the sign shown indicates a hotel with a guarded car park.

explain.short: The bed is the sleeper on the train, not a hotel. The sign is about cars travelling by train.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a train wagon carrying a car and a bed: a railway station where cars travel on the train with their owner ('auto al seguito'). It is near the entrance where cars are loaded. The traveller rides in the train, not in the car.
explain.trap: 'hotel' is wrong: the bed means you sleep on the train.

sceneParams.caption: Not a hotel: a car-carrying train

q21781.en: The sign shown indicates that you can stay in your car while it is carried by train.

explain.short: The car travels on a wagon; the traveller rides in the passenger coaches (the bed), not inside the car.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a train wagon carrying a car and a bed: a railway station where cars travel on the train with their owner ('auto al seguito'). It is near the entrance where cars are loaded. The traveller rides in the train, not in the car.
explain.trap: 'restare in auto' (stay in the car) is wrong: you travel separately on the train.

sceneParams.caption: You travel in the train, not in your car

q21782.en: The sign shown means that the area is covered by the signal for satellite anti-theft systems.

explain.short: Nothing on the sign is about anti-theft devices: it shows a car on a train wagon.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a train wagon carrying a car and a bed: a railway station where cars travel on the train with their owner ('auto al seguito'). It is near the entrance where cars are loaded. The traveller rides in the train, not in the car.
explain.trap: 'antifurti satellitari' (satellite anti-theft devices) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Not anti-theft: car transport by train

q21783.en: The sign shown marks an area reserved for parking campervans.

explain.short: The vehicle is a car on a train wagon, not a campervan in a parking area.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a train wagon carrying a car and a bed: a railway station where cars travel on the train with their owner ('auto al seguito'). It is near the entrance where cars are loaded. The traveller rides in the train, not in the car.
explain.trap: 'autocaravan' (campervan) is wrong: it is a car on a train.

sceneParams.caption: Not camper parking: car on a train

q21784.en: The sign shown indicates an equipped area with emptying facilities for vehicles that have toilet facilities.

explain.short: The arrow from the campervan down to the ground shows waste being emptied at a service point.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'impianti di scarico' (emptying facilities): the arrow shows emptying.

sceneParams.caption: Camper service point: empty waste here

q21785.en: The sign shown indicates an area with sanitary facilities to collect the waste water of campervans.

explain.short: At this area campervans can empty their waste water into a collection point.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'raccogliere le acque' (collect the water): the facility receives the campervan's waste water.

sceneParams.caption: Campervan waste water collected here

q21786.en: The sign shown concerns all vehicles that have sanitary facilities on board.

explain.short: The service point is for every vehicle with a toilet or sink on board, not only campervans.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'tutti' (all) is right here: any vehicle with these systems may use it.

sceneParams.caption: For every vehicle with on-board toilets

q21787.en: The sign shown indicates facilities that let vehicles with toilet facilities empty their organic waste and their clean and dirty water.

explain.short: This is exactly what a camper service point does: it takes toilet waste and used water.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'scarico dei residui organici e delle acque' (emptying organic waste and water): all of it is allowed here.

sceneParams.caption: Toilet waste and used water emptied here

q21788.en: The sign shown indicates toilets for travellers.

explain.short: The facilities are for emptying the vehicle's tanks, not public toilets for people.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'servizi igienici per i viaggiatori' (toilets for travellers) is wrong: it is for vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Not public toilets: for emptying vehicles

q21789.en: The sign shown marks a road reserved for campervans.

explain.short: It marks a service area for emptying waste, not a campervan-only road.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'strada riservata' (reserved road) is wrong: it is a service point.

sceneParams.caption: Not a camper road: a service point

q21790.en: The sign shown indicates a facility for weighing campervans.

explain.short: The arrow shows waste going down into a drain, not a weighing scale.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'pesatura' (weighing) is wrong: it is for emptying waste.

sceneParams.caption: Not a weighbridge: waste emptying

q21791.en: The sign shown warns you to watch out for potholes in the roadway.

explain.short: It is a blue information sign, not a red triangle danger sign. It shows a camper service point.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'buche' (potholes): the line under the arrow is a drain, not a hole in the road.

sceneParams.caption: Not a danger sign: camper service

q21792.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous dip in the road.

explain.short: A dip (cunetta) is shown on a red triangle danger sign. This blue sign shows a camper service point.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a campervan and an arrow down into a drain: an 'area attrezzata con impianti di scarico' (service area where vehicles with on-board toilets empty their waste and used water). It is for all vehicles with these systems, mostly campervans.
explain.trap: 'cunetta' (dip) is wrong: this is not a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not a dip: camper service point

q21793.en: The sign shown indicates a mechanic's workshop for vehicles.

explain.short: The spanner (wrench) is the symbol of a workshop where vehicles are repaired, and it is close by.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.
explain.trap: 'officina' (workshop): the spanner means vehicle repairs.

sceneParams.caption: Repair workshop for vehicles

q21794.en: The sign shown indicates that there is a mechanic's workshop for vehicles nearby.

explain.short: The spanner (wrench) is the symbol of a workshop where vehicles are repaired, and it is close by.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.
explain.trap: 'officina' (workshop): the spanner means vehicle repairs.

sceneParams.caption: Repair workshop nearby

q21795.en: The sign shown indicates a vehicle repair workshop nearby.

explain.short: The spanner (wrench) is the symbol of a workshop where vehicles are repaired, and it is close by.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.
explain.trap: 'officina' (workshop): the spanner means vehicle repairs.

sceneParams.caption: Vehicle repairs nearby

q21796.en: The sign shown indicates that a mechanic's workshop for vehicles can be found a short distance away.

explain.short: The spanner (wrench) is the symbol of a workshop where vehicles are repaired, and it is close by.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.
explain.trap: 'officina' (workshop): the spanner means vehicle repairs.

sceneParams.caption: Workshop a short distance away

q21797.en: The sign shown means watch out for workers coming out of a factory.

explain.short: The spanner means a repair workshop. It is a blue information sign, not a danger warning about workers.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.

sceneParams.caption: Not factory workers: a repair workshop

q21798.en: The sign shown indicates a fuel station.

explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.
explain.trap: 'distributore di carburante' (fuel station) has a pump symbol, not a spanner.

sceneParams.caption: Not fuel: a repair workshop

q21799.en: The sign shown indicates a rest area nearby.

explain.short: A spanner means vehicle repairs, not a place to stop and rest.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.
explain.trap: 'area di sosta' (rest area) is wrong: it is a workshop.

sceneParams.caption: Not a rest area: a repair workshop

q21800.en: The sign shown indicates road workers working on the road.

explain.short: Road works are shown by a red triangle with a man digging. This blue sign is a repair workshop.
explain.rule: Blue sign with a black spanner (wrench): 'officina meccanica' (repair workshop for vehicles) nearby.
explain.trap: 'cantonieri al lavoro' (road workers at work) is a danger sign, not this one.

sceneParams.caption: Not road works: a repair workshop

q21801.en: The sign shown marks the state border with a country that is part of the European Union.

explain.short: The ring of EU stars shows that the border is between two European Union countries.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'Unione Europea': the stars are the EU symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Border between EU countries

q21802.en: The sign shown is located at the state border with a European Union country.

explain.short: This sign is placed right at the border line, not before it.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'si trova al confine' (is located at the border): it marks the border itself.

sceneParams.caption: Placed right at the EU border

q21803.en: The sign shown marks the border between Italy and a member state of the European Union.

explain.short: It says ITALIA inside the EU stars: you are entering Italy from another EU country.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'l'Italia': the name on the sign is the country you are entering.

sceneParams.caption: Entering Italy from another EU state

q21804.en: The sign shown does not oblige you to stop at the state border.

explain.short: It is only an information sign: between EU countries you do not have to stop at the border.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'non obbliga' (does not oblige): the negative statement is correct.

sceneParams.caption: No obligation to stop at the border

q21805.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a police checkpoint near the state border.

explain.short: The sign only marks the border. It says nothing about a police checkpoint.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'posto di blocco' (police checkpoint) is not on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not a police checkpoint: just the border

q21806.en: The sign shown is placed on the back of a vehicle to show the country where it was registered.

explain.short: It is a road sign at the border, not a plate or sticker on a vehicle.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'dietro al veicolo' (on the back of the vehicle) is wrong: it stands by the road.

sceneParams.caption: A road sign, not a vehicle plate

keywords.en: on the back of the vehicle

q21807.en: The sign shown is placed on the back of a vehicle to show that it may only be driven in a European state.

explain.short: It is a road sign at the border, not something on a vehicle, and it does not limit where you drive.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'dietro al veicolo' and 'solo' are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: A border sign, not a vehicle limit

keywords.en: on the back of the vehicle

q21808.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop at the border with a European Union state.

explain.short: Between EU countries you do not have to stop: the sign is only information.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'obbliga ad arrestarsi' (obliges you to stop) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: No stop needed at an EU border

q21809.en: The sign shown gives advance warning that you must stop for a customs check when entering Italy.

explain.short: It does not warn of anything ahead and there is no customs stop between EU countries.
explain.rule: Blue square with the EU ring of stars and the name of a country: 'confine di Stato' (state border) between EU countries, placed at the border. The name is the country you are entering. There is no obligation to stop.
explain.trap: 'controllo doganale' (customs check) is wrong: no customs stop is required.

sceneParams.caption: No customs stop entering Italy from the EU

q21810.en: The sign shown gives advance notice of the state border with a country that is part of the European Union.

explain.short: The EU stars with FRANCE and '1 km' announce that the border with France is 1 km ahead.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'preavvisa' (gives advance notice): the 1 km panel shows the border is still ahead.

sceneParams.caption: EU border with France in 1 km

q21811.en: The sign shown is placed on roads that lead to the state border with a European Union country.

explain.short: It is put on the roads that go towards the border, before you reach it.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'strade che portano al confine' (roads that lead to the border): the sign is before the border.

sceneParams.caption: On the road towards the border

keywords.en: roads that lead to the border

q21812.en: The sign shown gives advance notice of the distance to the border with a state that is part of the European Union.

explain.short: The panel under the sign shows the distance: the border is 1 km ahead.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'la distanza' (the distance): that is the '1 km' on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: Border 1 km ahead

q21813.en: The sign shown does not oblige you to stop for a customs check at the state border.

explain.short: It is only information: between EU countries there is no obligation to stop for customs.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'non obbliga' (does not oblige): the negative statement is correct.

sceneParams.caption: No customs stop required

q21814.en: The sign shown is found near a police checkpoint.

explain.short: The sign announces a border, not a police checkpoint.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'posto di blocco' (police checkpoint) is not shown on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not a checkpoint: border in 1 km

q21815.en: The sign shown is placed on the back of vehicles to show their nationality.

explain.short: It is a road sign with a distance panel, not a sign on a vehicle.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'dietro ai veicoli' (on the back of vehicles) is wrong: it stands by the road.

sceneParams.caption: A road sign, not a nationality sticker

q21816.en: The sign shown is placed on the back of a vehicle to show that it belongs to a citizen of the European Union.

explain.short: It is a road sign announcing the border, not a sign on a vehicle about its owner.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'dietro al veicolo' (on the back of the vehicle) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: A border sign, not on a vehicle

keywords.en: on the back of the vehicle

q21817.en: The sign shown gives advance warning that you must stop at the border with a European Union state.

explain.short: It announces the border, but there is no obligation to stop between EU countries.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'obbligo di arresto' (obligation to stop) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Border ahead, but no stop needed

q21818.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop for a customs check when entering the territory of a European country.

explain.short: It is an information sign: it obliges nothing, and there is no customs stop between EU countries.
explain.rule: EU stars with a country name plus a distance panel (1 km): advance notice of the state border with an EU country (here France, 1 km ahead). It is on roads leading to the border. No customs stop is required.
explain.trap: 'obbliga' (obliges) is wrong: information signs give no orders.

sceneParams.caption: No customs stop: information only

q21819.en: The sign shown is placed near a road works site.

explain.short: The yellow background means a temporary sign used for road works.
explain.rule: Yellow background = temporary sign for road works (cantiere). The blue disc with a straight arrow is an obligation; the lorry symbols show it applies only to road trains and articulated lorries. It is a 'preavviso' (advance notice) before the junction.
explain.trap: 'cantiere stradale' (road works site): yellow signs belong to works.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow sign: road works nearby

q21820.en: The sign shown gives advance notice of the compulsory direction for road trains and articulated lorries.

explain.short: The blue disc with an arrow is an obligation, and the two lorries show who must follow it.
explain.rule: Yellow background = temporary sign for road works (cantiere). The blue disc with a straight arrow is an obligation; the lorry symbols show it applies only to road trains and articulated lorries. It is a 'preavviso' (advance notice) before the junction.
explain.trap: 'obbligatoria' (compulsory): a blue round disc is an obligation, not advice.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries: compulsory straight on (works)

q21821.en: The sign shown is installed for as long as the road works last.

explain.short: Yellow signs are temporary: they are put up for the works and removed afterwards.
explain.rule: Yellow background = temporary sign for road works (cantiere). The blue disc with a straight arrow is an obligation; the lorry symbols show it applies only to road trains and articulated lorries. It is a 'preavviso' (advance notice) before the junction.
explain.trap: 'per il periodo di durata dei lavori' (for the duration of the works): temporary, not permanent.

sceneParams.caption: Temporary: only while the works last

q21822.en: The sign shown gives advance notice of the way to a refuelling and rest area for heavy vehicles.

explain.short: It shows a compulsory direction for lorries because of road works, not the way to a lorry rest area.
explain.rule: Yellow background = temporary sign for road works (cantiere). The blue disc with a straight arrow is an obligation; the lorry symbols show it applies only to road trains and articulated lorries. It is a 'preavviso' (advance notice) before the junction.
explain.trap: 'area di rifornimento e sosta' (refuelling and rest area) is not on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not a lorry rest area: compulsory direction

q21823.en: The sign shown obliges all vehicles to continue straight on.

explain.short: The lorry symbols limit the obligation to road trains and articulated lorries. Other vehicles are not obliged.
explain.rule: Yellow background = temporary sign for road works (cantiere). The blue disc with a straight arrow is an obligation; the lorry symbols show it applies only to road trains and articulated lorries. It is a 'preavviso' (advance notice) before the junction.
explain.trap: 'tutti i veicoli' (all vehicles) is wrong: only the pictured lorries.

sceneParams.caption: Only the pictured lorries must go straight

q21824.en: The sign shown gives advance notice of a recommended direction.

explain.short: The blue round disc makes it an obligation, not advice.
explain.rule: Yellow background = temporary sign for road works (cantiere). The blue disc with a straight arrow is an obligation; the lorry symbols show it applies only to road trains and articulated lorries. It is a 'preavviso' (advance notice) before the junction.
explain.trap: 'consigliata' (recommended) is wrong: blue disc = compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory, not recommended

q21825.en: The sign shown advises all vehicles to follow the direction shown by the arrow.

explain.short: It does not advise, it obliges, and only road trains and articulated lorries.
explain.rule: Yellow background = temporary sign for road works (cantiere). The blue disc with a straight arrow is an obligation; the lorry symbols show it applies only to road trains and articulated lorries. It is a 'preavviso' (advance notice) before the junction.
explain.trap: 'consiglia a tutti i veicoli' (advises all vehicles): two mistakes, it is an obligation and only for lorries.

sceneParams.caption: An obligation, and only for lorries
